title.zh-TW: Claude Code 側邊面板登場，直接在終端機查看額度與背景工作
title.en: Claude Code Side Panel Arrives: Check Quota and Background Tasks Right in Your Terminal

body.zh-TW: 想在終端機裡隨時掌握 Claude Code 的用量與工作進度，現在有專屬的側邊面板可供使用。⟦在料理檯旁架起點單螢幕，廚師不必離開工作台翻帳本，抬頭就能看清各項出餐進度與備料。⟧這項功能需要支援介面外掛的較新版本 Claude Code（實測為 2.1.289 版）。在選單開啟後，開新對話或輸入 `/reload-plugins` 即可載入。終端機寬度大於等於 144 欄時會自動在右側展開，較窄時可輸入 `/usage-dash` 開啟。macOS 內建終端機僅支援 256 色可能產生灰底，可在 `/config` 選用 ANSI 深色主題。面板會以黃色標示等待授權或等待 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）輸入的對話，背景工作也會列出 Claude 透過 Agent 工具啟動的子代理與狀態。
body.en: If you want to keep an eye on Claude Code's usage and task progress from inside the terminal, there is now a dedicated side panel for that. ⟦It is like setting up an order screen next to the prep counter: the chef no longer has to leave the workstation to flip through the ledger, and can see every dish's progress and remaining ingredients just by looking up.⟧This feature requires a newer version of Claude Code that supports interface plugins (tested on version 2.1.289). After enabling it in the menu, start a new conversation or type `/reload-plugins` to load it. When the terminal is 144 columns wide or more, the panel expands automatically on the right; on narrower terminals, type `/usage-dash` to open it. The built-in macOS terminal only supports 256 colors, which may produce a gray background; you can select the ANSI dark theme in `/config`. The panel highlights in yellow any conversations waiting for authorization or waiting for MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) input, and background tasks also list the subagents launched by Claude through the Agent tool along with their status.

Open a new conversation or run `/reload-plugins` after enabling. The pane opens on the right automatically at terminal widths ≥144 columns; use `/usage-dash` in narrower terminals. macOS Terminal supports only 256 colors and may show a gray background; select an ANSI dark theme in `/config`. Conversations waiting for your permission or MCP input are marked in yellow across panes, and background jobs also list subagents started by Claude with the Agent tool and their status.

title.zh-TW: usage status 指令輸出 JSON 時納入 Antigravity 與 Grok 配額
title.en: usage status Now Includes Antigravity and Grok Quotas in JSON Output

body.zh-TW: 當你需要透過腳本取得完整的結構化數據時，`usage status --json` 現在會將 Antigravity 與 Grok 的額度資訊一併納入 JSON 輸出。⟦翻開帳目明細表，以前只列出單一帳戶，現在把其他分行的儲備與結算倒數也一併寫入。⟧這項改動會從本機快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用的儲存區）讀取所有 Antigravity 群組，並從本機紀錄讀取 Grok 帳務，同時附上配額重置倒數與資料年齡。如果你平時習慣直接閱讀文字版摘要，終端機顯示的純文字排版則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When you need to pull complete structured data through a script, `usage status --json` now includes quota information for Antigravity and Grok in the JSON output. ⟦Think of opening an account ledger: it used to list only a single account, but now the reserves and settlement countdowns from the other branches are written in as well.⟧This change reads all Antigravity groups from the local cache (a storage area that keeps previously fetched results ready for direct reuse) and reads Grok billing from local records, along with the quota reset countdown and data age. If you normally prefer reading the text summary directly, the plain-text layout shown in the terminal stays exactly the same as before.

items.original: **`usage status --json` includes Antigravity and Grok quotas.** Read all Antigravity groups from the local cache and Grok billing from its local log, with reset countdowns and snapshot ages. The text summary stays unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Claude Code 側邊面板自動更新元件，並優化時間與額度顯示
title.en: Claude Code Side Panel Auto-Updates Its Component and Improves Time and Quota Display

body.zh-TW: 針對 Claude Code 側邊面板的使用流程與介面呈現，這次更新修正了升級機制並改善多項數據顯示。當 usage 應用程式啟動時，會自動將已啟用的側邊面板更新至內建的最新版本，以前升級後必須手動關閉再重新開啟才能套用新版，現在完全不需多餘操作。面板上的資料更新時間在經過一分鐘後，會自動切換為顯示分鐘或小時。遇到缺少資料的額度窗口時，介面會直接隱藏該項目，不再錯誤顯示成 0%，讓你不會再誤以為配額已經見底。
body.en: For the Claude Code side panel's workflow and interface presentation, this update fixes the upgrade mechanism and improves several data displays. When the usage app starts, it now automatically updates the enabled side panel to the latest built-in version. Previously, after an upgrade you had to manually close and reopen the panel to apply the new version; now no extra steps are needed at all. Once the panel's data update time is more than a minute old, it automatically switches to showing minutes or hours. When a quota window has missing data, the interface now hides that item outright instead of incorrectly showing it as 0%, so you will no longer mistakenly think your quota has run dry.

items.original:
**Claude Code side pane:** when the usage app starts, an enabled pane is automatically updated to the bundled version, so upgrades no longer require toggling it off and on.
**Claude Code side pane:** the refresh age switches from seconds to minutes or hours after one minute.
**Claude Code side pane:** quota windows with missing data are hidden instead of appearing as 0%.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣選單的「結束」正常顯示，不再出現缺字方框
title.en: Windows System Tray Menu Correctly Displays "Exit" Without Missing-Glyph Boxes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦點擊工作列右下角想退出工具時，選單文字現在都能正確呈現。以前在系統匣（tray，常駐程式圖示聚集的區域）右鍵打開選單時，最底下的「結束」選項無法正常辨識。這是因為系統遇到了缺字方框（missing-glyph box，找不到對應字形時顯示的代用方塊），把文字替換成了空白方塊。現在這個顯示問題已經修好，「結束」二字會正常呈現。⟦像家電遙控器上的按鍵掉漆變成空白方塊，以前想關機只能憑位置盲猜，現在按鈕印字完整清晰，一眼就能看懂。⟧
body.en: When clicking the bottom-right corner of the taskbar on a Windows computer to exit the tool, menu text now displays correctly. Previously, right-clicking to open the menu in the system tray left the bottom "Exit" option unrecognizable. This happened because the system encountered missing-glyph boxes, replacing the text with blank squares. This display issue has now been fixed, and the word "Exit" appears normally. ⟦Picture a home appliance remote where worn-off button paint left blank squares, forcing you to guess the power button by position; now the button label is intact and clear, making it readable at a glance.⟧

items.original: **Windows:** the tray menu's "Quit" item no longer shows a missing-glyph box.

title.zh-TW: Windows 傳統主控台 Grok 狀態列不再蓋住配額百分比
title.en: Grok statusLine in Legacy Windows Console No Longer Covers Quota Percentages

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 舊版命令視窗中使用 Grok 模型時，你可能會看一眼配額百分比。以前在傳統主控台（console，Windows 內建的文字命令視窗）執行時，畫面容易出現排版重疊。特別是 Grok 的狀態列（statusLine，顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）會把旁邊的配額百分比直接蓋住，讓人看不清配額百分比。現在這個顯示問題已經修好，狀態文字與配額數字能同時清楚呈現。⟦如同停車場入口的電子看板，以前提示文字會把剩餘車位數蓋掉，現在車位數量與運作狀態各自獨立顯示，進場時一目了然。⟧
body.en: When using Grok models in older Windows command windows, you might glance at your quota percentage. Previously, running in a legacy console often caused layout overlapping on screen. In particular, the Grok statusLine directly covered the adjacent quota percentage, making it hard to see the quota percentage. This display issue has now been fixed, allowing status text and quota numbers to appear clearly at the same time. ⟦Think of an electronic sign at a parking garage entrance where prompt text used to block the remaining space count; now vacancy numbers and operational status display independently, making everything clear upon entry.⟧

items.original: **Windows:** the Grok status line in the classic console no longer overwrites the quota percentage.

entries: **The status line is shorter.** The first line now holds only the project and your two quotas; the context window moved to the end of the second line. The cache segment lost its bar and its countdown and shows just the hit rate (for example `Cache: 93%`) — the countdown read about 59 minutes almost every time, because Claude Code restarts it on every message and the status line does not redraw while you are idle.
The two quotas now show the reset clock time before the time remaining (for example `22:00 (3h45m left)`), and both are drawn in a dimmer colour.
The "cold cache, next message re-caches N tokens" text added in 0.31.4 is gone from the status line.
Add `gpt-6.1-sol` to the offline fallback price table, so its Codex usage is no longer priced at $0 when the downloaded price table is stale.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列排版精簡，重置時間與快取命中一目了然
title.en: Status Line Layout Streamlined for At-a-Glance Reset Times and Cache Hits

body.zh-TW: 在終端機專心配對程式碼時，螢幕最底部的即時資訊現在變得更短。⟦好比汽車儀表板精簡了多餘的指針，以前塞滿次要數據容易讓人分心，現在只留關鍵油量與里程，一眼就能看清現況。⟧第一行現在只保留專案名稱與兩個額度，上下文視窗（對話可容納的內容範圍）資訊則移至第二行末尾。兩個額度改用較暗的顏色顯示，並在剩餘時間前標出重置時刻，例如 22:00(剩 3h45m)。快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）區塊移除了進度條與倒數，改為僅顯示命中率，例如快取:93%。因為 Claude Code 每送出一則訊息就會重新計時，加上閒置時不會重畫畫面，導致倒數幾乎永遠停在約 59 分鐘，所以不再顯示。先前在 0.31.4 加入的「快取已冷、下輪重寫 N token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）」提示文字也一併從狀態列移除。
body.en: While pair programming in the terminal, the real-time information at the very bottom of the screen is now more concise. ⟦Think of a car dashboard stripping away unnecessary gauges: where cluttered secondary dials once caused distraction, only key fuel and mileage remain to check status at a glance.⟧ The first line now keeps only the project name and two quotas, while context window information moves to the end of the second line. The two quotas are displayed in a dimmer color, labeling the reset time before the remaining time, such as 22:00 (3h45m left). The cache section removes the progress bar and countdown, showing only the hit rate instead, such as cache:93%. Because Claude Code resets the timer every time a message is sent and does not redraw the screen when idle, the countdown almost permanently hovered around 59 minutes and is no longer shown. The hint text added in 0.31.4 noting that the cache has cooled down and N tokens will be rewritten next round has also been removed from the status line.

items.original:
**The status line is shorter.** The first line now holds only the project and your two quotas; the context window moved to the end of the second line. The cache segment lost its bar and its countdown and shows just the hit rate (for example `Cache: 93%`) — the countdown read about 59 minutes almost every time, because Claude Code restarts it on every message and the status line does not redraw while you are idle.
The two quotas now show the reset clock time before the time remaining (for example `22:00 (3h45m left)`), and both are drawn in a dimmer colour.
The "cold cache, next message re-caches N tokens" text added in 0.31.4 is gone from the status line.

title.zh-TW: 離線備援價目表補上新模型，過期時不再誤算為零元
title.en: Offline Fallback Price List Adds New Model to Prevent Zero-Dollar Miscalculations Upon Expiration

body.zh-TW: 當下載的價目表過期，你查看 gpt-6.1-sol 的 Codex 用量時，以前可能會看到 $0。⟦就像手上的商品價目表過期，店員改查備用表；以前備用表漏了新商品，價格被記成 0 元，現在備用表補上了這項商品。⟧內建的離線備援價目表正式補上 gpt-6.1-sol。以往只要下載的價目表過期，它的 Codex 用量就會被算成 $0；現在補齊清單後，這種情況下不會再被誤算。
body.en: When the downloaded price list expired and you checked Codex usage for gpt-6.1-sol, you might have previously seen $0. ⟦Picture a clerk consulting a backup catalog when the printed price list expires; where the backup sheet previously omitted new items and recorded their prices as $0, it now includes the missing listing.⟧ The built-in offline fallback price list officially adds gpt-6.1-sol. Previously, whenever the downloaded price list expired, Codex usage for this model was calculated as $0; with the list completed, it will no longer be miscalculated under these conditions.

items.original: Add `gpt-6.1-sol` to the offline fallback price table, so its Codex usage is no longer priced at $0 when the downloaded price table is stale.

entries: **Resuming a stale conversation now tells you what it will cost.** When Progress Concierge is on and you `/resume` (or `--resume` / `--continue`) a conversation whose prompt cache has expired and whose context is at least 50k tokens, Claude Code shows a one-line warning before your first message: how long it sat idle, roughly how many tokens the next message re-sends, and a suggestion to `/compact` first. Only you see it; it is never added to Claude's context. Needs Claude Code 2.1.251 or newer. Existing installs pick up the new trigger automatically the next time usage starts.

**The status line now says what a cold cache will cost.** Once the prompt cache countdown runs out, the segment switches to how many tokens the next message will re-cache (for example `cold·re-cache 180k`) instead of going blank. Claude Code redraws the status line the moment the cache expires, so no refresh interval is needed.
Quota warning and quota-depleted notifications now play a short two-note "uh-oh" alert sound made for usage. The quota-restored notification keeps the system default sound.

**Claude subagent output was undercounted by about 86%.** Claude Code writes each subagent request to its transcript several times while it streams, and `output_tokens` only reaches its final value on the last line. Both Claude parsers kept the first line, so on one machine 17 subagent transcripts counted 23,327 output tokens instead of 165,395. They now keep the largest value for each request. Main-conversation transcripts were not affected. The history and yearly caches are rebuilt once; days whose transcripts were already deleted keep their archived totals and cannot be corrected.

Add Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) to the offline fallback price table, so its usage is no longer priced at $0 when the downloaded price table is stale, and show it as "Sonnet 5.5" in tables instead of a truncated model ID.

title.zh-TW: 接回舊對話與狀態列即時提醒，快取過期成本一目了然
title.en: Resuming Old Conversations with Real-Time Status Line Alerts Makes Cache Expiration Costs Clear

body.zh-TW: 當你暫停工作後想接續先前任務，常因快取（暫存計算結果的機制）過期而重送大量資料。開啟進度管家後，只要以 `/resume`、`--resume` 或 `--continue` 接回過期且脈絡達 5 萬 token（AI 計費的文字單位）的對話，Claude Code 會在輸入首句前顯示一行提示，列出閒置時間、預估重送的 token 數並建議先執行 `/compact`。此提示僅自己可見且不計入脈絡，需 2.1.251 以上版本且下次啟動 usage 自動套用。狀態列在倒數結束後也不再留白，到期當下會即時重畫，顯示如 `cold·re-cache 180k` 的提示，表示下一則訊息約有 18 萬 token 要重新快取。⟦如同退房時櫃檯即時試算加時費用，以前超時往往結帳才發現驚人帳單，現在一到超時點就主動亮出補收標準，讓你能提前評估是否精簡內容。⟧
body.en: When resuming previous tasks after taking a break, users often resend large amounts of data due to expired caches. With Progress Manager enabled, whenever you resume an expired conversation with at least 50k tokens of context using `/resume`, `--resume`, or `--continue`, Claude Code displays a single-line notice before you enter your first prompt. This notice details the idle duration and the estimated number of tokens to resend, while suggesting that you run `/compact` first. Visible only to you, this prompt is excluded from context, requires version 2.1.251 or later, and applies automatically the next time usage launches. The status line also no longer goes blank when the countdown ends. Instead, it redraws immediately upon expiration to show prompts like `cold·re-cache 180k`, indicating that the next message will re-cache approximately 180k tokens. ⟦Picture a hotel front desk calculating overtime charges the moment checkout passes: instead of discovering a surprise bill at final settlement, you immediately see the extra fees and can decide in advance whether to trim your stay.⟧

items.original:
**Resuming a stale conversation now tells you what it will cost.** When Progress Concierge is on and you `/resume` (or `--resume` / `--continue`) a conversation whose prompt cache has expired and whose context is at least 50k tokens, Claude Code shows a one-line warning before your first message: how long it sat idle, roughly how many tokens the next message re-sends, and a suggestion to `/compact` first. Only you see it; it is never added to Claude's context. Needs Claude Code 2.1.251 or newer. Existing installs pick up the new trigger automatically the next time usage starts.
**The status line now says what a cold cache will cost.** Once the prompt cache countdown runs out, the segment switches to how many tokens the next message will re-cache (for example `cold·re-cache 180k`) instead of going blank. Claude Code redraws the status line the moment the cache expires, so no refresh interval is needed.

title.zh-TW: 額度快用完改播專屬短音，告急提醒更具辨識度
title.en: Distinct Chimes for Dwindling Quotas Make Low-Quota Alerts Instantly Recognizable

body.zh-TW: 埋頭趕工或專注思考時，如果沒有時常緊盯著用量面板，額度（特定週期內可使用的調用配額上限）見底的瞬間往往讓人猝不及防。現在系統調整了通知音效，當額度快用完或已經用完時，會改播 usage 自製的兩聲「uh-oh」簡短警示音，讓你光聽聲音就能分辨用量告急。至於額度恢復時的通知，則繼續維持播放系統預設的提示音，避免干擾既有的使用習慣。⟦洗衣機遇到排水故障時用短促警示，洗好衣服則播放一般完成音；現在額度告急有專屬短音，額度恢復仍是系統預設音，光聽就能分辨。⟧
body.en: When rushing through work or deep in thought, running out of quota without watching the usage popover can easily catch you off guard. The system has now updated its notification sounds. Whenever quota is running low or fully exhausted, usage plays a custom two-tone "uh-oh" short alert, letting you recognize the urgent status by sound alone. Notifications for quota recovery continue to play the default system chime, preserving your established workflow habits. ⟦A washing machine beeps with a sharp warning when drainage fails but plays a standard completion chime when the cycle finishes smoothly. In the same way, quota exhaustion now triggers a dedicated short tone while recovery uses the default system sound, making them distinguishable by ear alone.⟧

items.original: Quota warning and quota-depleted notifications now play a short two-note "uh-oh" alert sound made for usage. The quota-restored notification keeps the system default sound.

title.zh-TW: 修正子代理輸出少算問題，歷史快取自動重新結算
title.en: Fixing Undercounted Subagent Outputs and Automatically Recalculating Historical Caches

body.zh-TW: 習慣呼叫多個背景助手平行處理繁重任務的使用者，過去看到的用量統計可能嚴重失真。先前在串流（答案一邊生成一邊逐字傳輸的輸出方式）處理時，Claude Code 會把同一請求多次寫入日誌，導致解析器只抓到第一行，使子代理的輸出用量少算約 86%。例如在某台機器上的 17 個子代理日誌中，原本僅記錄到 23,327 個輸出 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），修正後改取每筆請求的最大值，實際數值應為 165,395。這項問題只影響子代理，主對話日誌完全不受影響；更新後歷史快取與年度快取會自動重算一次，但日誌已遭刪除的日期則維持封存數字無法補正。⟦好比收銀機結帳時印出整串明細，以前系統只抓取了剛開始印出的第一行小計，導致整筆交易總額嚴重短少；現在改以最終印出的加總金額為準，歷史紀錄重新結算後用量數字終於回歸真實。⟧
body.en: Users accustomed to spawning multiple background assistants for parallel tasks may have previously seen severely skewed usage statistics. During streaming responses, Claude Code wrote the same request to logs multiple times. This caused the parser to capture only the first line, undercounting subagent output usage by about 86%. For example, across 17 subagent logs on one machine, only 23,327 output tokens were initially recorded; after switching to taking the maximum value per request, the actual count was 165,395. This issue affected only subagents, leaving main session logs completely untouched. After the update, historical and annual caches are automatically recalculated once, though dates whose logs were deleted remain archived and cannot be retroactively fixed. ⟦Think of a cash register printing a long receipt where the system previously captured only the first line of subtotal, causing the recorded total to fall drastically short. By taking the final printed sum instead, historical records are recalculated and usage numbers reflect reality at last.⟧

items.original: **Claude subagent output was undercounted by about 86%.** Claude Code writes each subagent request to its transcript several times while it streams, and `output_tokens` only reaches its final value on the last line. Both Claude parsers kept the first line, so on one machine 17 subagent transcripts counted 23,327 output tokens instead of 165,395. They now keep the largest value for each request. Main-conversation transcripts were not affected. The history and yearly caches are rebuilt once; days whose transcripts were already deleted keep their archived totals and cannot be corrected.

title.zh-TW: 離線備用價目表補上 Sonnet 5.5，名稱顯示不再截斷
title.en: Offline Fallback Pricing Adds Sonnet 5.5 and Fixes Truncated Model Names

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或離線環境工作時，最怕計費工具因連不上伺服器而無法正確計算新型號的花費。現在離線備援（主要機制失效時接手的後備清單）價目表正式補上了新模型資料，完整納入 `claude-sonnet-5-5` 的費率。以前當下載的線上價目表過期時，這款模型的用量會被誤算為 0 美元；現在即使離線也能依正確標準計價，終端機表格中也會顯示為清晰的「Sonnet 5.5」，不再出現被截斷的模型識別碼。⟦彷彿隨身攜帶的紙本價目表補齊了最新熱門品項，以前網路斷線時查不到新餐點價格會直接被當成免費招待，現在備援清單完整對齊，就算離線結算也不會漏算費用。⟧
body.en: When working offline or during network outages, cost tracking tools often fail to price new models accurately without server access. The offline fallback pricing table now officially incorporates new model data, fully including rates for `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Previously, when the downloaded online pricing expired, usage for this model was miscalculated as $0. Now it is priced correctly even offline, and terminal tables clearly display "Sonnet 5.5" rather than a truncated model identifier. ⟦Like a printed menu updated with the newest popular dishes, where disconnected servers previously treated unknown items as free on the house, the fallback list is now fully aligned so offline calculations never miss a charge.⟧

items.original: Add Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) to the offline fallback price table, so its usage is no longer priced at $0 when the downloaded price table is stale, and show it as "Sonnet 5.5" in tables instead of a truncated model ID.

entries: Bring the Heart Monitor panel's project list and footer text up to the size every other theme uses. Project names, token counts, costs, the project actions, the status strip, today's total and the footer buttons were 1–3px smaller and looked out of place under the large quota readouts.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板字級對齊其他主題，專案明細不再偏小
title.en: ECG popover font sizes align with other themes so project details are no longer undersized

body.zh-TW: 當你切換到心電圖面板追蹤用量時，專案清單與底部的文字讀起來更協調了。⟦像看銀行寄來的對帳單，以前總額底下的一筆筆明細被印得特別小，上下對照總覺得比例失調；現在各欄位字級調整一致，一眼望去就能看清每筆收支。⟧以前在這個主題中，專案名稱、token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數、金額、專案動作按鈕、狀態列、今日金額與頁尾按鈕，字級原本都比平常小了 1 到 3px。這些文字放在大號額度讀數下方時顯得很突兀，現在心電圖面板的專案用量與頁尾字級已調回正常大小，與其他主題保持一致。
body.en: When you switch to the ECG popover to track usage, text across the project list and bottom section now reads with greater visual balance. ⟦Picture reviewing a bank statement where individual line items below the total were previously printed unusually small, creating an awkward visual contrast; now all fields share a consistent font size so you can clearly scan every expense at a glance.⟧ Previously in this theme, project names, token counts, costs, project action buttons, the status bar, today's total, and footer buttons were all 1 to 3px smaller than usual. That text looked out of place beneath the large quota readout, but project usage and footer font sizes in the ECG popover have now been restored to their standard scale, staying consistent with all other themes.

items.original: Bring the Heart Monitor panel's project list and footer text up to the size every other theme uses. Project names, token counts, costs, the project actions, the status strip, today's total and the footer buttons were 1–3px smaller and looked out of place under the large quota readouts.

entries: Tidy the Heart Monitor panel's project list and footer: project rows line up as a data table with thin bars and outlined rank chips, the three project actions form one segmented control whose lit state follows the real status-line setting, and the footer becomes a status strip. The quota cards keep their original look.
Add Sketchbook and Heart Monitor to the README theme gallery and to the website's panel carousel.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板重整專案用量與頁尾，按鈕即時連動狀態列設定
title.en: ECG Popover Reorganizes Project Usage and Footer with Real-Time Status-Line Sync

body.zh-TW: 想在終端機裡查看各專案的資源消耗時，現在心電圖面板能呈現更工整清晰的排版。⟦如同走進重新規畫的控制室，以前各項指標高低不一且按鈕各自為政，現在所有數值按欄位整齊排好，開關指示燈也直接與主系統連線同步。⟧心電圖面板的專案列已改為對齊的數據表，搭配細長條與外框名次標籤，讓用量多寡與排行一目了然。原本的三個專案動作整合成一組分段按鈕，按鈕亮起狀態會跟著真正的 status-line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）設定走，避免顯示與背後設定脫節。底部頁尾換上精簡的狀態列樣式，而上方的額度卡片則維持原本外觀。
body.en: When checking resource consumption across projects in the terminal, the ECG popover now presents a cleaner, more organized layout. ⟦Picture stepping into a redesigned control room: where scattered meters and isolated switches once operated independently, all readings are now arranged in aligned columns and indicator lights stay in sync with the main system.⟧ The project rows in the ECG popover are now structured into an aligned data table with slender bars and boxed rank tags, making usage levels and rankings clear at a glance. The previous three project actions are consolidated into a segmented button group, and the active button state mirrors the actual status-line configuration to prevent display mismatch. The bottom footer adopts a streamlined status-line style, while the quota cards above retain their original appearance.

items.original: Tidy the Heart Monitor panel's project list and footer: project rows line up as a data table with thin bars and outlined rank chips, the three project actions form one segmented control whose lit state follows the real status-line setting, and the footer becomes a status strip. The quota cards keep their original look.

title.zh-TW: 說明文件與官網展示收錄手繪筆記與心電圖新主題
title.en: Documentation and Website Add Handdrawn and ECG Theme Previews

body.zh-TW: 想在挑選主題前先預覽介面外觀，現在不必親自安裝切換就能直接看見效果。⟦好比走進線上家具型錄，以前新推出的配色沒有附上實景展示，想看搭配只能買回家組裝；現在目錄首頁就放上情境輪播，一眼就能比對每套風格的實際質感。⟧說明文件裡的 README 主題展示（theme gallery，列出各種外觀風格的範例區）與官方網站的面板輪播，現在同步收錄了「手繪筆記」與「心電圖」兩款樣式。你可以在網頁上直接看清不同主題在面板上的排版細節，挑選順眼的風格後再套用到終端機環境中。
body.en: When previewing interface styles before picking a theme, you can now see the results directly without installing and switching themes yourself. ⟦Like flipping through an online furniture catalog where new color schemes previously lacked room previews and required assembling them at home, the homepage now provides an interactive carousel to compare the exact look of every style at a glance.⟧ The README theme gallery in the documentation and the popover carousel on the official website now include both the "Handdrawn" and "ECG" themes. You can inspect layout details across themes directly on the web and pick your favorite style before applying it to your terminal.

items.original: Add Sketchbook and Heart Monitor to the README theme gallery and to the website's panel carousel.

entries: **Heart Monitor panel theme.** A hospital-monitor look on a dark grid: every quota row scrolls an ECG trace whose peaks grow taller and faster as usage rises, next to a large monospace readout. The 50% / 80% warning and danger colors and the 80% mark still apply, and the animation stops when Reduce Motion is on. Available on macOS and Windows; the panel count is now 16.

Size the Windows panel from the scale its page is really rendered at, so it no longer scrolls when Windows' "Text size" is not 100% (a follow-up to [#153](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/153)). Text size multiplies WebView2's device pixel ratio on top of the display scale (125% × 109% = 1.3625), but `GetDpiForWindow` does not include it, so a window sized with the display scale alone came out about 8% shorter than its content: a scrollbar appeared although the screen had room to spare, and hiding a card did not help. The panel page now reports its `devicePixelRatio` together with its content height, and the window size, work area, saved position and legibility floor are converted with it, falling back to the display scale until the page has reported one. pywebview's `resize()` / `move()` multiply by the display scale themselves, so they are corrected by the ratio between the two.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板主題登場，用量高低化為即時跳動波形
title.en: Heart Monitor popover theme debuts, turning quota usage into live pulsing waveforms

body.zh-TW: 在日常盯著各家模型額度時，你現在能用醫院監視器風格的畫面掌握消耗狀況。⟦像看跑車儀表板上的動態轉速表，以前查用量只能盯著單純的數字進度，現在消耗節奏直接化為起伏波形，用量越凶波峰跳得越急。⟧新加入的心電圖（Heart Monitor）主題採用深色網格背景。每一列額度旁邊都有一條持續捲動的心電圖與等寬大字讀數，當用量越高，波峰會長得越高且跳動得越快。原本的 50% 與 80% 警示及危險配色，以及 80% 記號都完整保留。如果你在系統中開啟了「減少動態效果」，波形動畫就會貼心暫停。這項主題在 macOS 與 Windows 都能使用，讓可選的面板總數增加到 16 款。
body.en: When keeping an eye on model quotas each day, you can now track consumption with a hospital-monitor style interface. ⟦Picture a dynamic tachometer on a sports car dashboard: while you previously checked usage by staring at plain numeric progress, consumption rhythm is now rendered as an undulating waveform where heavier usage triggers faster, taller peaks.⟧ The newly added Heart Monitor theme features a dark grid background. Next to each quota row is a continuously scrolling ECG trace alongside large monospace readings; as usage rises, the peaks grow taller and pulse faster. The original warning and danger color schemes for 50% and 80%, along with the 80% marker, are fully preserved. If you have "Reduce Motion" enabled in your system settings, the waveform animation pauses automatically. This theme is available on macOS and Windows, bringing the total number of selectable themes to 16.

items.original: **Heart Monitor panel theme.** A hospital-monitor look on a dark grid: every quota row scrolls an ECG trace whose peaks grow taller and faster as usage rises, next to a large monospace readout. The 50% / 80% warning and danger colors and the 80% mark still apply, and the animation stops when Reduce Motion is on. Available on macOS and Windows; the panel count is now 16.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板視窗精準貼合內容，放大文字不再冒出多餘捲軸
title.en: Windows popover window fits content accurately, eliminating unwanted scrollbars when scaling text

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Windows 調大文字大小，開啟面板不會再看到擠在邊緣的垂直捲軸。⟦照片接連放大兩次，若相框只照第一次尺寸做，邊緣仍會被擠住；按最後尺寸做才裝得下。⟧這是先前視窗問題（[#153]）的後續改進。若 Windows「文字大小」非 100%，會在顯示縮放外疊加 WebView2 縮放倍率（如 125% 乘 109% 達 1.3625）。舊版 `GetDpiForWindow` 未計入這層放大，使視窗比內容矮約 8% 而冒出捲軸，隱藏卡片也沒用。現在頁面會回報內容高度與 `devicePixelRatio`（實際顯示倍率），面板依此換算視窗大小、工作區、已存位置與可讀性下限，未回報前則退回顯示縮放。針對 pywebview 呼叫 `resize()` 與 `move()` 重複乘上縮放的問題，也依兩者比值補正。
body.en: When you increase text size on Windows, opening the popover will no longer display a vertical scrollbar crammed against the edge. ⟦When a photo is enlarged twice in succession, building the frame based only on the first resize still cramps the edges; only sizing it for the final dimensions makes everything fit.⟧ This is a follow-up improvement to a previous window issue ([#153]). If Windows "Text size" is not 100%, WebView2 zoom is compounded on top of display scaling, such as 125% multiplied by 109% reaching 1.3625. The legacy `GetDpiForWindow` did not account for this extra scaling layer, leaving the window roughly 8% shorter than its content and causing scrollbars to appear even if cards were hidden. The page now reports content height and `devicePixelRatio` (effective display scale), which the popover uses to calculate window dimensions, workspace, saved positions, and readability floors, falling back to display scale before reporting occurs. To address pywebview redundantly multiplying scaling on `resize()` and `move()` calls, values are corrected using the ratio between both scales.

items.original: Size the Windows panel from the scale its page is really rendered at, so it no longer scrolls when Windows' "Text size" is not 100% (a follow-up to [#153](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/153)). Text size multiplies WebView2's device pixel ratio on top of the display scale (125% × 109% = 1.3625), but `GetDpiForWindow` does not include it, so a window sized with the display scale alone came out about 8% shorter than its content: a scrollbar appeared although the screen had room to spare, and hiding a card did not help. The panel page now reports its `devicePixelRatio` together with its content height, and the window size, work area, saved position and legibility floor are converted with it, falling back to the display scale until the page has reported one. pywebview's `resize()` / `move()` multiply by the display scale themselves, so they are corrected by the ratio between the two.

entries: **Sketchbook panel theme.** A hand-drawn notebook look on grid paper: every quota shows as a half-circle gauge with a needle, the percentage sits in large ink over a highlighter stroke in each provider's color, and the 50% / 80% warning and danger colors and the fixed 80% mark still apply. Available on macOS and Windows; the panel count is now 15.

Keep the whole Windows panel on screen on short high-DPI displays, so the Refresh Now and Quit buttons are no longer cut off ([#153](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/153)). The panel now reads the target monitor's work area straight from Windows instead of relying on the screen size pywebview reports, sizes the zoom and the window from the same monitor, never lets the window's bottom edge pass the taskbar, and becomes scrollable if even the smallest readable zoom cannot fit.

Date Antigravity turns by their own time again. Antigravity CLI 1.1.18 and later no longer store a per-turn time where usage read it, so every turn of a multi-day conversation landed on the day it started. Turn times now come from the conversation's steps table, and the local caches are rebuilt once so older dates are recomputed.

Stop panel height and automatic zoom from repeatedly adjusting each other on macOS, which could make Origami jitter. Keep a conservative height during zoom-only fitting while allowing changed content to shrink, and cover automatic-fit stability and content transitions in the browser regression.

title.zh-TW: 新增手繪筆記主題，額度化身方格紙半圓儀表
title.en: New Sketchbook Theme Turns Quotas into Grid-Paper Semicircle Gauges

body.zh-TW: 平常盯著制式數據介面覺得單調時，現在能換上更有手感的新樣式來掌握用量。這次新增的手繪筆記（Sketchbook）面板主題，將方格紙質感搬上螢幕。介面把每個額度（quota，各家服務分配的使用上限）畫成帶指針的半圓儀表，並以深墨色大字搭配代表色螢光筆底線標示百分比。既有的 50% 與 80% 警示配色與固定的 80% 記號完全保留，macOS 與 Windows 都支援，讓面板總數來到 15 款。⟦好比隨手翻開手繪帳本，以前只見到整排冷冰冰的規格數據，現在每筆紀錄都像用麥克筆畫上刻度與底線，一眼就能看清進度。⟧
body.en: If you find standard data interfaces monotonous, you can now switch to a more tactile style to track your usage. The newly added Sketchbook popover theme brings a graph paper texture to your screen. The interface renders each quota as a semicircle gauge with a needle, displaying large dark-ink percentages with highlighter underlines in each service’s representative color. Existing warning color schemes for 50% and 80% as well as the fixed 80% mark are fully retained across macOS and Windows, bringing the total number of popover themes to 15. ⟦Picture opening a hand-drawn ledger: where there used to be rows of cold metric figures, every entry is now marked with clear dial scales and highlighter underlines, making progress visible at a glance.⟧

items.original: **Sketchbook panel theme.** A hand-drawn notebook look on grid paper: every quota shows as a half-circle gauge with a needle, the percentage sits in large ink over a highlighter stroke in each provider's color, and the 50% / 80% warning and danger colors and the fixed 80% mark still apply. Available on macOS and Windows; the panel count is now 15.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板完整顯示，底部操作按鈕不再被切掉
title.en: Full Windows Popover Display Prevents Bottom Action Buttons from Being Clipped

body.zh-TW: 在直向高度較矮的高解析度螢幕上使用 Windows 版，再也不必煩惱底部按鈕被擠出畫面外。以前面板仰賴 pywebview（負責在桌面呈現網頁介面的工具庫）回報的尺寸，容易算錯空間，導致「立即更新」與「結束」按鈕被切掉。現在面板直接向 Windows 讀取目標螢幕扣掉工作列後的可用範圍，縮放比例與視窗大小也改用同一個螢幕計算，視窗底邊絕不超過工作列。即使縮到最小可讀比例仍放不下，面板也會自動轉成可以捲動瀏覽。⟦如同依照牆面高度調整的展示架，以前只顧著展開而把底層按鈕擠到地板下，現在先扣除邊界空間並支援捲動，讓所有操作隨時都能點得到。⟧
body.en: When using the Windows version on high-resolution displays with shorter vertical heights, you no longer have to worry about bottom buttons being pushed offscreen. Previously, the popover relied on dimensions reported by pywebview (a library that renders web interfaces on the desktop), which often miscalculated space and cut off the "Update Now" and "Quit" buttons. Now, the popover directly queries Windows for the available area on the target display excluding the taskbar, and both the scale factor and window size are calculated from that same display so the bottom edge never exceeds the taskbar. Even if content cannot fit at the minimum readable scale, the popover automatically switches to a scrollable view. ⟦Think of a display rack tailored to wall height: instead of expanding blindly and pushing lower shelves under the floor, it accounts for boundary margins first and supports scrolling so every control stays within reach.⟧

items.original: Keep the whole Windows panel on screen on short high-DPI displays, so the Refresh Now and Quit buttons are no longer cut off ([#153](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/153)). The panel now reads the target monitor's work area straight from Windows instead of relying on the screen size pywebview reports, sizes the zoom and the window from the same monitor, never lets the window's bottom edge pass the taskbar, and becomes scrollable if even the smallest readable zoom cannot fit.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 跨天對話每輪各自計日，日期分佈更精準
title.en: Antigravity Multi-Day Chats Track Turns Daily for Accurate Date Distribution

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓同一個 AI 對話跨好幾天持續進行，用量圖表現在能如實呈現每天的真實消耗。從 Antigravity CLI 1.1.18 開始，系統不再把每輪對話時間存在原本的位置，導致跨天交談的每一輪用量全被歸到對話開始的第一天。現在程式改從對話的 steps（記錄每一步互動細節的資料表）讀取每輪時間。系統同時會主動重建一次本機快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存起來直接用的機制），讓過去受影響的歷史日期全部重新計算校正。⟦跟逐日核銷費用的記帳本一樣，以前跨天出差只要寫在同一張申請單，所有花費全被算在出發第一天；現在改依每張明細的確切時間分別記帳，舊帳目也一併重新整理歸位。⟧
body.en: If you regularly keep the same AI conversation running over multiple days, usage charts now accurately reflect daily consumption. Starting with Antigravity CLI 1.1.18, the system no longer stores turn timestamps in their original location, which previously caused all usage across multi-day chats to be attributed to the first day. The application now reads individual turn timestamps from conversation steps (a table recording details for each interaction step). The system also proactively rebuilds the local cache once, recalculating and correcting all affected historical dates. ⟦Like a daily expense ledger where multi-day business trips used to dump every receipt onto the departure date on a single claim, expenses are now booked by the exact time of each item while older records are reconciled into place.⟧

items.original: Date Antigravity turns by their own time again. Antigravity CLI 1.1.18 and later no longer store a per-turn time where usage read it, so every turn of a multi-day conversation landed on the day it started. Turn times now come from the conversation's steps table, and the local caches are rebuilt once so older dates are recomputed.

title.zh-TW: 修正 macOS 摺紙主題抖動，面板縮放不再反覆拉扯
title.en: Fix macOS Origami Theme Jitter to Stop Popover Scaling Conflicts

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 上選用摺紙風格面板時，介面不再因為尺寸計算打架而產生惱人的微小震顫。以前 macOS 上的面板高度與自動縮放機制會反覆互相觸發，導致 Origami（摺紙主題）介面持續抖動。現在程式在單純調整縮放時會保留足夠的高度空間，同時確保內容增減時依然能正常縮小。開發團隊也補上了瀏覽器回歸測試（browser regression，用自動化腳本驗證既有功能未被改壞的測試），涵蓋自動調整的穩定性與內容切換。⟦就像相機自動對焦找到穩定焦距，以前視窗與縮放比例互相干擾導致畫面不斷抽搐，現在設定好適當緩衝，既能隨內容靈活伸縮又不再無故晃動。⟧
body.en: When selecting the origami-style popover on a Mac, the interface no longer suffers from annoying micro-jitters caused by competing size calculations. Previously on macOS, popover height and automatic scaling repeatedly triggered each other, causing the Origami theme interface to jitter continuously. Now, the application preserves sufficient height headroom during pure scale adjustments while ensuring it can still shrink properly as content changes. The development team also added browser regression tests (automated scripts that verify existing features remain unbroken), covering auto-fit stability and content switching. ⟦Just as camera autofocus locks onto a stable focal length, where window sizing and scale factors once interfered and caused constant screen twitching, proper buffer spacing now allows smooth resizing with content without unprovoked shaking.⟧

items.original: Stop panel height and automatic zoom from repeatedly adjusting each other on macOS, which could make Origami jitter. Keep a conservative height during zoom-only fitting while allowing changed content to shrink, and cover automatic-fit stability and content transitions in the browser regression.

entries: **Dispatch ledger in the HTML report.** The top-conversations table gains an "Approx. weekly quota" column, and a new "Dispatch ledger (last 7 days)" section matches the `codex exec` / `agy -p` calls in a Claude conversation to the Codex and Antigravity conversations they started, estimating how much of each provider's weekly quota one task used: conversation tokens (excluding cache reads) ÷ the period's total tokens × that provider's weekly quota used. A dispatch is attributed by Claude's conversation UUID first, then by a -5 to +120 second time window, then by working directory; if it is still ambiguous it stays unattributed. It reads local files only — Antigravity's quota comes from the existing cache, with no new network call — and the section is omitted when there were no dispatches.
Tagging a release now also publishes `usage-cli` to PyPI through Trusted Publishing, with no stored token.

Keep footer action labels and buttons visible in the ten affected panel themes when the status-line setup button is shown, including narrow panels and longer translations. Allow local wrapping and natural button height while preserving theme chrome. Measure content at the displayed zoom so WebKit font metrics and line wrapping cannot clip the footer after panel scaling ([#151](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/151)).

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表新增派工帳本，清楚看懂跨工具額度消耗
title.en: HTML Reports Add Delegation Ledger to Track Multi-Tool Quota Consumption

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 Claude 呼叫其他工具一起分工寫程式時，往往很難算清一項任務到底扣了哪一邊的用量。⟦像工程主管核對跨包商工單，以前只見到月底整筆總支出，現在能清清楚楚拆解出每個專案各自攤提了哪家廠商的工時。⟧現在 HTML 報表的最耗用對話清單新增了「約佔週額度」欄位，並加入「派工帳本（最近 7 天）」區塊。它會將對話中的 `codex exec` 與 `agy -p` 呼叫，對應回 Codex 與 Antigravity 的紀錄。消耗估算是以對話消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）佔比，乘以各平台已使用的週額度。計算時會自動排除快取（把查過的資料暫存起來直接用）讀取的份額。歸屬依序比對對話識別碼、負五至一百二十秒的時間窗與工作目錄；若仍無法確認，就保持未歸屬。全程只讀取本機檔案與既有快取，不發送額外網路請求，沒有派工時也不會顯示此區塊。
body.en: When you have Claude delegate coding tasks to external tools, tracking which platform consumed quota for a specific task can be difficult. ⟦Think of an engineering manager auditing contractor invoices: where they once saw only a lump-sum bill at month-end, they can now clearly break down which vendor's hours were billed to each project.⟧ The top-spending conversations list in the HTML report now adds an "Est. % of Weekly Quota" column and introduces a "Delegation Ledger (Last 7 Days)" section. It maps `codex exec` and `agy -p` invocations within conversations back to Codex and Antigravity records. Usage estimation multiplies the conversation's token consumption share by each platform's used weekly quota. The calculation automatically excludes cached reads. Attribution matches sequentially by conversation ID, a time window of -5 to 120 seconds, and working directory; if it still cannot be confirmed, it remains unassigned. The entire process reads only local files and existing caches without making additional network requests, and the section is hidden when no delegation occurred.

items.original: **Dispatch ledger in the HTML report.** The top-conversations table gains an "Approx. weekly quota" column, and a new "Dispatch ledger (last 7 days)" section matches the `codex exec` / `agy -p` calls in a Claude conversation to the Codex and Antigravity conversations they started, estimating how much of each provider's weekly quota one task used: conversation tokens (excluding cache reads) ÷ the period's total tokens × that provider's weekly quota used. A dispatch is attributed by Claude's conversation UUID first, then by a -5 to +120 second time window, then by working directory; if it is still ambiguous it stays unattributed. It reads local files only — Antigravity's quota comes from the existing cache, with no new network call — and the section is omitted when there were no dispatches.

title.zh-TW: 發行版本自動上傳套件庫，免存認證金鑰更安全
title.en: Automated Releases Upload to Package Index Without Storing Authentication Keys

body.zh-TW: 想要把維護好的工具打包發布，現在只要為專案建立版本標籤，流程就會透過受信任發布機制（Trusted Publishing，透過平台互信驗證身分的安全機制）自動將 `usage-cli` 送上 Python 套件庫 PyPI。⟦好比大樓改用身分認證自動辨識進出，以前必須在管理室押一把實體備用鑰匙，現在通過驗證就直接放行，櫃子裡不必保存任何密碼鑰匙。⟧整個自動化發布流程完全不需要在設定中存放任何 token（授權令牌），只要打上標籤發版就能安全完成發布，不必擔心金鑰外洩。
body.en: When publishing maintained tools, creating a version tag on the project will now automatically upload `usage-cli` to the Python package index PyPI via Trusted Publishing, a mechanism that verifies identity through trust between platforms. ⟦Picture a secure building switching to automated identity verification: instead of leaving a physical spare key with the front desk, visitors are granted entry directly upon authentication without storing any keys or combinations in a locker.⟧ The entire automated release workflow eliminates the need to store authorization tokens in settings. Tagging a release safely completes deployment without the risk of credential leakage.

items.original: Tagging a release now also publishes `usage-cli` to PyPI through Trusted Publishing, with no stored token.

title.zh-TW: 面板底部按鈕不再被裁切，窄版介面完整顯示操作文字
title.en: Popover Bottom Buttons No Longer Clipped Across Narrow Layouts

body.zh-TW: 當你在使用較窄的面板主題或是切換到文字較長的語言介面時，可能會發現底部的操作按鈕被切掉半截。⟦如同排版軟體依照實際縮放比例重新測量元件，以前視窗縮放後，邊界文字會被擠出畫面；現在文字可就地換行，按鈕高度也會自然調整，字樣不再被切掉。⟧這次修正解決了十款面板主題在顯示狀態列（顯示在終端機最底部的即時資訊列）設定按鈕時，底部標籤與按鈕溢出的問題。介面現在會依實際縮放比例精確測量內容，避免 WebKit 引擎縮放後的字體差異造成底部被截斷，同時保留各主題原本的外觀風格。
body.en: When using a narrow popover theme or switching to a language with longer text strings, you might find the bottom action buttons cut off. ⟦Like publishing software remeasuring elements against the actual zoom scale, where window resizing previously pushed edge text off-screen, text now wraps in place while button heights adjust naturally so labels are never clipped.⟧ This fix resolves bottom label and button overflow across 10 popover themes when displaying status line settings buttons. The interface now accurately measures content based on the actual scale factor, preventing font rendering discrepancies in the WebKit engine from truncating the bottom while preserving each theme's original visual styling.

items.original: Keep footer action labels and buttons visible in the ten affected panel themes when the status-line setup button is shown, including narrow panels and longer translations. Allow local wrapping and natural button height while preserving theme chrome. Measure content at the displayed zoom so WebKit font metrics and line wrapping cannot clip the footer after panel scaling ([#151](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/151)).

entries: **Switch the Antigravity card between its two quota pools.** Antigravity keeps separate Gemini and Claude / GPT quotas, and the card used to show only Gemini — so anyone working mainly with Claude models in Antigravity never saw their own numbers (#150). A small tag next to the title now always names the pool on screen; tap `Gemini ⇄` to switch to `Claude / GPT ⇄` and back. The choice is remembered, the switch redraws from the last fetched snapshot without another network call, and the burn-rate forecast restarts so the two pools never blend into one prediction. It works in the 13 themes that have an Antigravity card, on macOS and Windows.

**Muse Code spending.** Muse Code's per-request tokens and cost now count toward today's cost, project totals, the HTML report, and the `usage` CLI. They are read from `~/.local/share/muse/sessions/**/session.jsonl`, deduplicated by record ID, and priced from LiteLLM's `meta/muse-*` entries, with `muse-spark-1.3` added to the offline fallback table. Muse keeps no local quota data, so there is no Muse quota card.
Bumped ruff to 0.16.8, `astral-sh/setup-uv` to 10.2.0, and the CodeQL actions.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 卡片支援切換兩組額度
title.en: Antigravity Cards Support Switching Between Two Quota Sets

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 Antigravity 裡習慣呼叫 Claude 或 GPT 模型，以前工具卡片上永遠只顯示 Gemini 的消耗量。現在標題旁多了一個常駐標籤顯示目前的模型組別，點擊 `Gemini ⇄` 就能切換成 `Claude / GPT ⇄`，系統會記住你的選擇。切換時會直接以最近一次抓取的快照重繪畫面，完全不需再次發送網路請求，並重新啟動消耗速度預測，避免兩組額度混合計算。這項功能支援全數 13 款包含 Antigravity 卡片的主題，且在 macOS 與 Windows 上都能運作。⟦跟雙幣帳戶在手機上翻頁查帳一樣，以前只顯示台幣餘額，現在按一下就能查看外幣，切換時直接讀取剛剛的紀錄而不必重打網路，兩邊的扣款預測也不會混在一起。⟧
body.en: If you regularly use Claude or GPT models in Antigravity, tool cards previously only displayed Gemini usage. A persistent badge next to the title now shows the current model group, allowing you to click `Gemini ⇄` to switch to `Claude / GPT ⇄`, and the system remembers your choice. Switching immediately redraws the interface using the most recent snapshot without making another network request, while restarting burn rate predictions to keep both quota calculations separate. This feature supports all 13 themes containing Antigravity cards and runs on both macOS and Windows. ⟦Think of checking a mobile dual-currency account: it previously showed only the local balance, but now a single tap reveals foreign currency, directly loading recent records without new network requests and keeping deduction forecasts from mixing together.⟧

A small tag next to the title now always names the pool on screen; tap `Gemini ⇄` to switch to `Claude / GPT ⇄` and back. The choice is remembered, the switch redraws from the last fetched snapshot without another network call, and the burn-rate forecast restarts so the two pools never blend into one prediction. It works in the 13 themes that have an Antigravity card, on macOS and Windows.

title.zh-TW: Muse Code 呼叫花費納入統計與報表
title.en: Muse Code Usage Costs Included in Statistics and Reports

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案中使用 Muse Code 輔助寫程式時，現在它產生的每筆費用都能被完整追蹤。工具會讀取 `~/.local/share/muse/sessions/**/session.jsonl` 中的工作階段紀錄，依據紀錄 ID 排除重複項目，並以每次請求消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）對照 LiteLLM 的 `meta/muse-*` 模型價格計算金額。這些花費會計入今日開銷、專案累積總計、HTML 報表與 `usage` 命令列工具。即使在斷網環境下，離線備援價目表也已補上 `muse-spark-1.3` 的計費依據。由於 Muse 本身沒有存放本機額度資料，因此不會額外提供 Muse 額度卡片。⟦好比總務人員定期整理出差單據，以前分散在各處的零星開銷無人清查，現在按紀錄編號剔除重複並對照標準價目，即便離線也有備用表可查，全數彙整到當日帳本中。⟧
body.en: When you use Muse Code to assist with coding in your projects, every expense it generates is now fully tracked. The tool reads session records in `~/.local/share/muse/sessions/**/session.jsonl`, deduplicates entries by record ID, and calculates costs by matching tokens consumed per request against LiteLLM `meta/muse-*` model pricing. These expenses are included in today's spending, project cumulative totals, HTML reports, and the `usage` command-line tool. Even when disconnected, the offline fallback price list includes billing rates for `muse-spark-1.3`. Because Muse does not store local quota data, no additional Muse quota card is provided. ⟦Picture an administrative clerk sorting travel receipts: previously scattered expenses went unchecked, but now duplicates are removed by record ID and matched against standard rates—with an offline backup table on hand—fully compiling everything into the daily ledger.⟧

items.original: **Muse Code spending.** Muse Code's per-request tokens and cost now count toward today's cost, project totals, the HTML report, and the `usage` CLI. They are read from `~/.local/share/muse/sessions/**/session.jsonl`, deduplicated by record ID, and priced from LiteLLM's `meta/muse-*` entries, with `muse-spark-1.3` added to the offline fallback table. Muse keeps no local quota data, so there is no Muse quota card.

title.zh-TW: 開發工具版本更新
title.en: Development Tool Version Updates

body.zh-TW: 你在檢查專案的自動化工作流程時，想確認底層換了什麼，清單列出三項：ruff 更新到 0.16.8，`astral-sh/setup-uv` 更新到 10.2.0，CodeQL actions 也更新了；原文沒有提供 CodeQL actions 的新版本號。這份紀錄只列更新項目，沒有交代這次換版後的實際效果。⟦像核對器材更換單，前兩件寫出新型號，第三件只註明已更換；拿到這張單，你知道哪些器材換過，卻不知道換後用起來有何不同。⟧
body.en: When checking your project's automated workflow to see what changed underneath, the list outlines three items: ruff was updated to 0.16.8, `astral-sh/setup-uv` was updated to 10.2.0, and CodeQL actions was also updated, though the source provided no new version number for CodeQL actions. This log only lists updated items without explaining the actual effects of the version bump. ⟦Checking an equipment replacement form works similarly: the first two items list new model numbers while the third only notes it was replaced; holding this slip, you know which equipment was swapped, but not how it feels to use afterward.⟧
